Entries.Description: A sarcastic, erotic, and tense gaze into the private, professional and social lives of Istanbulite artists whose lives intertwine with fiction.

Entries.Title: Reflection
Entries.Description: A quirky receptionist in a hotel in Istanbul welcomes guests as they tumble upon their daily struggles, all to end up in a mix of chaos and dread after the arrival of a mysterious man who declares that he is their patron Saint.

Entries.Title: Dolma
Entries.Description: Bora, a young man with dreams of becoming a well-known actor visits his parents in his childhood home in expectation of a peaceful dinner. He gets tangled up in opinions and situations he did not see coming.

Entries.Title: Ali Çevlik
Entries.Description: The story of former boxing champion and coach Sinan Cevahir, who wants to go to Paris, and his efforts to find a champion boxer from the club's inactive Bingöl branch, following a sudden decision by the club president.

Entries.Title: Make a Wish
Entries.Description: In one parallel coming-of-age story, Kaan is faced with being uprooted from home; in the other, Berke is faced with bullying. Both demonstrate that when you know and choose what you want - Make a Wish - you can change your life.

Entries.Title: Distant Mirror
Entries.Description: A magical realist, inner drama about a soldier who, when negotiating a minefield steps on a landmine and in his inner turmoil, he imagines he encounters a mirror that is a gateway into one very specific memory.

Entries.Title: Visceral
Entries.Description: A lawyer dives into the heart of the organ mafia to save her son.

Entries.Title: Hopeful Dark Journey
Entries.Description: Yılmaz is a civil servant. There are two months until his retirement. His only dream is to build a house on his ‘little piece of land’. However, will the trouble his son Fırat who suddenly turned up without notice in the middle of the night, got himself in take away Yılmaz’s dream?

Entries.Title: Guilt
Entries.Description: Reyhan, raised in a religious family, arrives to spend her summer holidays at her grandmother Ummu's house in a conservative central Anatolian village, accompanied by her mother Hatice, and her 6 year old brother Mehmet. The 13 year old is gripped by a state of inner turmoil. She has just had her first period and dreads the consequences of being unable to perform the required religious rites. Reyhan's concerns mount after she finds out the water supply at her grandmother's village house is cut off. She is desperate to find a way to perform the required religious ablution rites, which she has always been told will protect her from attacks by djinns and facial disfiguration. She starts having nightmares. At the same time, Reyhan is also determined to help Şükran, her best friend in the village.

Entries.Title: As Possible As Everything
Entries.Description: Saadet, who lives in Basaksehir, one of the urban transformation areas of Istanbul, arranged a job interview by means of her father's former boss pulling some strings.

Entries.Title: The Life of a Snowflake
Entries.Description: In Trabzon, snow falls heavily like never before in the last days of autumn, and the roads are blocked. In this setting, two people who attend the same school but have never met have a chance encounter at a bus station, waiting for the same bus that has run late. They fall in love at first sight.

Entries.Title: You All and I Alone
Entries.Description: Deniz is a lecturer loved by his surroundings. There is electricity in Deniz's flat while there is a power outage covering the whole of Istanbul. Feeling lucky at first, Deniz starts to get lonely as the interruption continues.

Entries.Title: Bandırma Füze Kulübü
Entries.Description: When the calendars showed the 1950s, curiosity and interest in space had reached new heights, and many countries from Europe to Asia, led by the United States and the Soviet Union, had launched space programs and entered into fierce competition to reach beyond the unknowns of the sky. By 1957, the Soviet Union had become the first country to launch a rocket into space with Sputnik, followed by the United States as the second to make history. During these years, high school students and their friends living in Bandırma were inspired by Sputnik to pursue their dreams of space exploration. Despite lacking a space program, government support, or financial resources, they established the "Bandırma Rocket Club" with the aim of launching a rocket into space.

Entries.Title: İstanbul İstanbul
Entries.Description: Constantine and his wife, who are in their 70s, could not leave Istanbul, a city the Greeks were compelled to leave at different times for many various reasons. With the death of his wife, Constantine is overcome by thoughts and dreams about the past by associating his wife with Istanbul. Just like his wife, who never wanted to leave Istanbul, he cannot break away from her or the city.

Entries.Title: Annemin Zamanı
Entries.Description: Zehra Ana, who is in her seventies, is an elderly woman who has spent most of her life in a village. When her entire family moves to the city, she is forced to leave her village as well. Zehra Ana lives with her eldest son Kerim, following family traditions. Unable to adjust to city life, Zehra Ana is later diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease. The illness deeply affects both Zehra Ana and her son Kerim. Despite having five siblings, Kerim takes sole responsibility for his mother's care and does everything he can for her.

Entries.Title: A Night in Four Parts
Entries.Description: Two former high school buddies meet on a raki night in Beyoğlu after 17 years. As they drink and talk they realize another life is possible on a land where toxic masculinity does not exist. They represent the great divide in Turkish gay society: The lonely self-declared homosexuals and the married hypocrites.

Entries.Title: Not Today
Entries.Description: Handling two homes, three kids and her mother with Alzheimer's; Meryem, a single mother nanny, gets hooked on middle class' discourse of self-help. Going over her priorities, she decides to step up for herself on the worst day possible.

Entries.Title: Dünya Sürgünü
Entries.Description: It tells the life of Turkish poet, writer, thinker and politician Sezai Karakoç.

Entries.Title: Tower
Entries.Description: The sun rises on a Sunday morning in Berlin. On her way home, Derin finds herself thinking about what she left behind. She remembers why and how she moved abroad.

Entries.Title: A Hope
Entries.Description: Umut(35) is an actor who wants to act in movies, Asiye(43), is a director at their private theater company. following umut’s father’s death, his mother marries a man with three children, and he is sent to live with his uncle in bursa. he has not had any contact with his mother for twenty years. until he is told that his mother has come to bursa for her illness. so he is forced to take care of her. at the same time learns about asiye’s pregnancy. the situation causes a massive crisis in his life. because of all the feelings, umut accumulated over the years, he lives a great showdown with his mother.

Entries.Title: Şöhretler Okulu
Entries.Description: Teacher Kemal (Ediz Hun) had to raise his daughter alone. In this process, he took responsibility for his daughter's education and missed being her playmate. Teacher Deniz (Berna Üçkaleler) complains about her father not being able to take care of her when she was little because of his workload, and plans to take over Kaktüs College and sell it. In order to regain the time he missed with his daughter and to prove to his daughter how valuable special people each of our children are, Teacher Kemal proposes a race to Teacher Deniz, using the inter-school festival as an excuse. Since Teacher Deniz is sure that he will win the competition, he immediately accepts this competition offer. However, the children's team consisting of Popstar, Atom, Arabesk, Messi, Obelix, Ayaklı Gazete, Hack-i Can, Organiz and Einstein will radically change the situation.

Entries.Title: Down from the Clouds
Entries.Description: Su is 9 years old girl who waits for her father to come home with her favourite ice-cream.He arrives home visibly drunk and he still wants to keep his promise to his daugther. The two head our for a night drive in the magical land of Cappadocia.

Entries.Title: Zuhal
Entries.Description: Zuhal, a successful lawyer living alone in the center of Istanbul, begins to hear the sound of a cat in her house one day. She sets out on a quest in her apartment to find this cat, which no one has heard of but herself.

Entries.Title: Aga
Entries.Description: Salim, Veysel and Şenol are three brothers living in a rural house. Salim and Veysel work as shepherds, while Şenol, forced to leave school by Salim, cares for their bedridden mother and handles household chores. Salim’s costly dream of marriage binds the brothers, leading to a final confrontation.

Entries.Title: Killing The Rose
Entries.Description: The last moments of a man on trial for killing the rose, on the way of madness.

Entries.Title: Breakwater
Entries.Description: Aslan, a young insecure fisherman who lives on a Turkish island, finds a valuable lobster cave while diving. Knowing this treasure will bring him wealth and the prestige that he has never had in his society, he decides to keep it a secret from his cousin and best friend Yilmaz until he can properly harvest the lobsters by himself. By not sharing the secret, Yilmaz's growing suspicion conjures a series of paranoid obsessions that thrust him into a downward spiral.

Entries.Title: Dial-Up Sound
Entries.Description: The last therapy of young artist Umut Bey, who has attachment issues with Onur Bey, a psychiatrist who is devoted to his profession, turns upside down when Onur Bey announces that he has cancer. In the face of death, all meanings are lost and all that remains is to talk about dreams.

Entries.Title: The Loop of Fear
Entries.Description: A story of a kid named Onur fighting his psychological fears inside his own persona trapped in a loop of dreams.

Entries.Title: Faces
Entries.Description: Personal memory exists to the extent that it is shaped by the individual's own time and place. Proust states that it is a re-creation of the past by saying "memories developed by the mind", Even if the state of forgetting is inevitable, the form of the past changes with the images in the consciousness. In the short film, the director examines the interaction with memory, time, and space in a visual context, using different media, based on the daily life and encounters of her grandmother, who was diagnosed with Alzheimer's 15 years ago.

Entries.Title: Jülide
Entries.Description: Late at night, Jülide wakes up with the noises coming from upstair. She runs up to see if her neighboor is okay. There she finds a a total stranger, Kaan, who is about to commit suicide.

Entries.Title: Saf
Entries.Description: Turkish director Ali Vatansever weighs the human cost of politically motivated urban renewal in his achingly resonant second feature, about a young couple forced to compromise their ideals and work for the very industry encroaching on their Istanbul neighbourhood, in order to keep up with the rent.

Entries.Title: Alkarisi
Entries.Description: Kübra stays in the country house of her grandmother Emine with her illegitimate newborn baby. She hears of a creature named Alkarısı, which is rumored to kill newborn babies, haunts her village and finds herself in the middle of a dark folk tale.

Entries.Title: My Father's Air Bed
Entries.Description: After receiving the news that his father, whom he has not spoken to for five years, has cancer, Orkun goes to his father's home with his older sister Elif to take care of his father. The beginning of the treatment is also the beginning of the family's reckoning, and Orkun's camera records this process. A family autobiography accompanied by death, My Father's Air Bed.

Entries.Title: The Gulf
Entries.Description: Living in a world that cannot be taken out during the day, the little girls of a 3-member nuclear family forget the doll at the warehouse a little ahead of the house and leave the house during the day, pushing the mother to make a choice about her life. A short but difficult journey between the house and the warehouse awaits her.

Entries.Title: Leyla
Entries.Description: Leyla is a student in the middle school who sees the weightlifting competition announcement and the laptop that will be given as a prize at the school gate.

Entries.Title: Akifler
Entries.Description: Ali Kemal and Niko were childhood friends during the years when Anatolia was under occupation. One day, Niko comes to Ali Kemal with the news of the National Anthem. He tries to persuade Ali Kemal to participate in the competition. But Ali Kemal's plan is different.

Entries.Title: The Same
Entries.Description: While Ahmet is going to meet his girlfriend on the seaside, he sees her with another man. But actually there are two of the same woman.

Entries.Title: Barış Akarsu: Merhaba
Entries.Description: A life story of Barış Akarsu, who was a Turkish rock musician and actor.

Entries.Title: Cânn
Entries.Description: Beren is a young girl preparing for her university entrance exams. After returning from a camp she attended, Beren suddenly falls ill. At this time, her father Salih is abroad for work, and her stepmother Nurdan, who loves her like her own daughter, calls her brother Doğu to stay with them, thinking it will be good for her. However, shortly after Doğu and his wife Nergis arrive, events unfold that will deeply affect everyone's lives. Because Beren has become physically and psychologically ill due to a spell cast on her.

Entries.Title: The Hunt
Entries.Description: The retired soldier,  interested in hunting, lives alone after his daughter leaves home and the death of his wife. He goes out every other day for bird hunting with his old dog. We witness the loneliness and the waiting cycle of the man who does not give the game meat to his dog and does not eat it himself.

Entries.Title: Footprints of Ants
Entries.Description: In a tent camp where asylum seekers and local agricultural workers stays together, the anger of the local workers against the refugees increases with the poverty. Two children, Barış and Evin, who are unaware of this anger, disappear one day. Local and refugee workers in the tents go out to find for the children. During the search, local and refugee workers feel common feelings for a while. The search for children turns into a search for human values along the way.

Entries.Title: The Librarian
Entries.Description: About how the social environment affects Mazhar's consciousness/inner world and his effort to get rid of the stuckness he is in.

Entries.Title: A Quiet Summer
Entries.Description: Ada, a 17-year-old teenager faces social pressures from her family while she pursues her first summer romance. Things take a turn for the worst when her carefree cousin arrives.

Entries.Title: Loop
Entries.Description: The girl who unable to find a short film to send in her university application, realizes that she cannot see what is in front of her eyes.

Entries.Title: The Neighborhood
Entries.Description: A well-located but poor district in Istanbul, surrounded by gardens, flowers, and trees, is to be leveled by a construction company in order to be able to build higher-quality real estate there. There is resistance to these plans, especially among young people in the neighborhood.

Entries.Title: Şanzıman
Entries.Description: A group of men teasing each other and making show of strength in Mehmet's Industrial store while they are drinking and chatting. Faces with his childnood and masculinity when he becomes alone, Mehmet deepens conversation with himself by including a small camping tube thrown at his door as a threat.

Entries.Title: Invisible
Entries.Description: A suicidal man has become virtually invisible in his social circle.

Entries.Title: Idle Hands
Entries.Description: The theater of cruelty in third wheeling.

Entries.Title: FORTE
Entries.Description: Hamza (17) is a religious boy who grew up in Qur'an courses under the pressure of religion since his childhood. One evening, piano sounds rise from the open window of a house in an alley that he entered unknowingly. Hamza admires the sound of the piano and tells his family that he wants to play the piano. Hamza, who has received a bad reaction from his family, has to make a choice between the piano that haunts his dreams and his family.

Entries.Title: The Banishment
Entries.Description: Ziko is a young obsessed sleepwalker who has just been banished from his village for a serious crime. When this decision is announced to the neighboring villages, to reach the city, in the middle of winter he has to cross villages which await him with hatred, ignoring all this the deaf-mute LALO must also cross the same villages the same day.

Entries.Title: Zencefil
Entries.Description: An overprotective friend murders her bestie's boyfriend, thinking she's doing everyone a favor.

Entries.Title: Neighboring Sounds
Entries.Description: Bilal and Aylin, a young married couple, overhear a domestic battery occurring in their neighbourhood late at night. Despite his initial negligence, Bilal works up a curiosity which paves the way for an unwanted exposure.
